title: detent
description: Runs coding agents against a queue of tasks and lets nothing finish until the repository's own checks pass. A second model reads every green diff and may demote, never approve. Each run is a journal line: which model, how many rounds, how long, how much.

title: Har Kun AI
description: A streaming chat with a language model that can be stopped mid-sentence without losing what already arrived. The API key never reaches the browser, and the whole interface runs with no key at all against a built-in mock.

title: Yuk Markaz 24
description: A freight marketplace that puts cargo owners, logistics companies and drivers in one place — filtered search by route, cargo type, date and price, with ratings and direct contact instead of intermediaries. Four applications to production in four months: an administrative panel, a dispatcher workspace, a driver mobile application and the landing page.

title: QMed
description: A SaaS platform for small private clinics in Uzbekistan, where scheduling still runs on Excel, WhatsApp and paper. Three products over one API and one database: a keyboard-first desktop workspace for reception, a mobile application doctors use during the visit, and a public site for each clinic. Seven repositories sharing one documentation layer, with thirty-three decisions recorded as ADRs.
